---

## Task

Automatically identify regions where vegetation patterns are predominantly terrain-driven across different hydroclimatic and latitudinal backgrounds, in order to validate the Fan et al. (2019) framework.

---

## Input data description

```{r DataPre}
# Load resampled raster datasets (MI, TWI, fused)

mi_55km_r <- terra::rast(mi_55km_file) * 0.0001 # Multiply all values by 0.0001 to get original value
fused_55km_r <- terra::rast(fused_55km_file)
fbare_55km_r <- terra::rast(fbare_55km_file)
fwater_55km_r <- terra::rast(fwater_55km_file)
fsnow_55km_r <- terra::rast(fsnow_55km_file)
dem_sd_55km_r <- terra::rast(dem_sd_55km_path)
dem_rg_98p_02p_55km_r <- terra::rast(dem_rg_98p_02p_55km_path)
fpa_55km_r <- terra::rast(fpa_55km_path)
mat_55km_r <- terra::rast(mat_55km_file)
fveg_55km_r <- terra::rast(fveg_55km_path)

# Stack rasters with explicit layer names
stacked <- c(
  mi_55km_r,
  fused_55km_r,
  fbare_55km_r,
  fwater_55km_r,
  fsnow_55km_r,
  dem_sd_55km_r,
  dem_rg_98p_02p_55km_r,
  fpa_55km_r,
  mat_55km_r,
  fveg_55km_r
)

# Convert to data.frame 
df <- as.data.frame(stacked, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
df <- df[complete.cases(df), ]

# easy to make mistake here!
colnames(df) <-  c("lon", "lat",
                   "mi", "fused", "fbare", "fwater", "fsnow", "relief", 
                   "dem_rg_98p_02p", "fpa", "mat", "fveg")

# Clean up
rm(mi_55km_r, fused_55km_r, fbare_55km_r, fwater_55km_r, fsnow_55km_r, dem_sd_55km_r, 
   dem_rg_98p_02p_55km_r, fpa_55km_r,  mat_55km_r, fveg_55km_r)
gc()


# load coast outline, vector data for plotting
coast <- rnaturalearth::ne_coastline(scale = 110, returnclass = "sf")
```

---

## Binning Variables

```{r Bin, echo = TRUE}
df_binned <- df |>

  # create bins
  mutate(
    # mi_bin = cut(mi, breaks = quantile(mi, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/5)), include.lowest = TRUE),
    mi_bin = cut(mi, breaks = c(0, 0.03, 0.2, 0.5, 0.65, 0.8, Inf), include.lowest = TRUE),
    relief_bin = cut(relief, breaks = quantile(relief, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/3)), include.lowest = TRUE),
    abs_lat = abs(lat),
    abs_lat_bin = cut(abs_lat, breaks = quantile(abs_lat, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/5)), include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) |>

  # Assign readable labels to each bin
  mutate(
    mi_label = case_when(
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[1] ~ "1_hyper_arid",
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[2] ~ "2_arid",
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[3] ~ "3_semiarid",
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[4] ~ "4_dry_subhumid",
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[5] ~ "5_humid",
      mi_bin == levels(mi_bin)[6] ~ "6_perhumid"
    ),
    relief_label = case_when(
      relief_bin == levels(relief_bin)[1] ~ "flat_relief",
      relief_bin == levels(relief_bin)[2] ~ "mod_relief",
      relief_bin == levels(relief_bin)[3] ~ "rugged_relief"
    ),
    lat_label = case_when(
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[1] ~ "1_low_lat",
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[2] ~ "2_low_to_mid_lat",
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[3] ~ "3_mid_lat",
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[4] ~ "4_mid_to_high_lat",
      abs_lat_bin == levels(abs_lat_bin)[5] ~ "5_high_lat"
    )
  ) |>

  # Combine text labels into new readable strata labels
  mutate(
    strata_label = paste0(mi_label, "_", lat_label, "_", relief_label),
  ) |>

  select(-mi_label, -relief_label, -lat_label)

# check data
table(df_binned$mi_bin)
table(df_binned$abs_lat_bin)
table(df_binned$relief_bin)

table(df_binned$strata_label)
```

---

## Filtering Candidate Regions

```{r FilterA, echo = TRUE}

df_filt <- df_binned |>
  
  filter(relief_bin %in% levels(relief_bin)[c(3)],) |>
  
  filter(fused < 0.03) |>  # Exclude the region with high human activity 
  
  filter(fsnow < 0.1) |>  #  avoid high invalid or cold areas (permanent ice, and snow).
  
  filter(fwater < 0.3) |> # avoid regions with high invalid areas ( water bodies)
  
  # filter(fbare < 0.9) |>  # avoid regions with high invalid areas ( bare land)
  
  filter(fveg > 0.7) |> # avoid regions with very limited vegetation
  
  filter(fpa > 0.5) |> # select regions with 50% protected areas
  
  filter(dem_rg_98p_02p < 500)  # avoid the strong influence of a large elevation gradient differences

# print the numbers of possible region
table(df_filt$strata_label)
```

---

## Sampling Representative Locations

```{r Sampling}

set.seed(216)

df_samples <- df_filt |>
  group_by(strata_label) |>
  group_modify(~ slice_sample(.x, n = 1)) |>
  mutate(
    xmin = round(lon - 0.25, 1),
    xmax = round(lon + 0.25, 1),
    ymin = round(lat - 0.25, 1),
    ymax = round(lat + 0.25, 1),
    xmid = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
    ymid = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
    sample_id = ""
  ) |>
  ungroup() 

# Save the two data frames as RDS files
saveRDS(df_samples, reg_sample_info_path)
```

```{r plot_location}

# Load world map
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

text_size <- 12

p_loc <- ggplot(data = world) +
  geom_sf(fill = "gray95", color = "gray70") +
  geom_point(
    data = reg_info,
    aes(x = xmid, y = ymid, color = strata_label),
    size = 1
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-60, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Location of Sample Region",
    color = "Region"
  ) +
  scale_color_scico_d(palette = "roma") + 
  theme_bw(base_size = text_size) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = text_size * 0.8, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = text_size * 0.8, angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(size = text_size * 1.2, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 3)),
    plot.title.position = "panel",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )
reg_info
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("data/figures/5_01_sample_region_location.svg"),
  plot     = p_loc,
  width    = 10,
  height   = 5,
  device = "svg",
  bg = "transparent"
)
```

```{r}
# regA_info
# regB_info
plot_vegh_by_reg <- function(reg_row,
                              text_size = 12,
                              fig_width = 14,
                              fig_height = 18) {

    # --- reg info ---
    reg_id <- paste0(reg_row$strata_label, "_", reg_row$sample_id)
    reg_extent <- terra::ext(reg_row$xmin, reg_row$xmax, reg_row$ymin, reg_row$ymax)
    reg_xmid <- reg_row$lon
    reg_ymid <- reg_row$lat

    # --- Vegetation Height Raster ---
    vegh_rc <- terra::rast(vegh_450m_mosaic_path) |> terra::crop(reg_extent)
    vegh_tmp_path <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("tile_", reg_id, "_vegh_450m.nc"))
    terra::writeCDF(vegh_rc, vegh_tmp_path, varnames = "vegh",overwrite = TRUE)
    rm(vegh_rc); gc()
    vegh_rc <- terra::rast(vegh_tmp_path)
    names(vegh_rc) <- "vegh"
    
    p_vegh <- plot_vegh(vegh_rc, extent = reg_extent, title_text = reg_id, text_size = text_size, x_step = 0.5, y_step = 0.5) + ggplot2::theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
    
    return(p_vegh)
    
    rm(vegh_rc);gc()

}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(reg_info))) {
  p <- plot_vegh_by_reg(reg_info[i, ])
  print(p)
}
```
